capabilities: Translate selected text in Markdown, PDFs, and Web Viewer pages
Insert translations below selections or translate whole notes in batch
Save excerpts and translations to a chosen note
Read selected text aloud with adjustable language and speed
extras: Requires desktop Obsidian 1.13.7 or later; mobile is not supported. API keys are stored in plugin settings inside the vault, so users are warned to keep them private when sharing or syncing. Scanned PDF pages need OCR before text selection works. The author points YouTube/subtitle use to a separate plugin, Video Player (AI integrated).
problem: Translating while reading in Obsidian usually means copying text into a separate chat app or translation site.

relations.evidence: For OpenAI or Anthropic, enter your own API key.
For OpenAI or Anthropic, enter your own API key.
For local Codex or Claude Code, install and sign in to that application first
set Codex command or Claude command if it is not found automatically
For YouTube/local playback, subtitles and screenshot notes, use Video Player (AI integrated).

requires.name: Codex or Claude Code CLI for local backends

summary: AI translation assistant that translates selected text, PDFs, web pages, and notes, explains vocabulary in context, and saves bilingual notes.
